messages.content: What type of personality am I?

function.name: calculate_big_five_traits
function.description: Calculate the big five personality traits based on a set of questions answered by the user. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

answers.description: Answers to a set of questions rated on a scale from 1 to 5.

calculate_percentile.description: If true, the percentile rank for each trait will also be calculated.

average_answers.description: If true, answers will be averaged across each trait's questions.

message.content:
Sure! Let’s find out your Big Five personality profile. Please answer the following 20 questions on a scale from **1 (Strongly Disagree)** to **5 (Strongly Agree)**:

| # | Question |
|---|----------|
| 1 | I enjoy being the center of attention. |
| 2 | I often feel nervous or anxious. |
| 3 | I prefer to plan things in advance rather than improvise. |
| 4 | I am quick to forgive others. |
| 5 | I like to try new experiences and take risks. |
| 6 | I am comfortable with people who are different from me. |
| 7 | I am usually calm and relaxed. |
| 8 | I am good at making friends. |
| 9 | I am organized and keep my life tidy. |
|10 | I am generous and share with others. |
|11 | I am a good listener. |
|12 | I am a natural leader. |
|13 | I am a good judge of character. |
|14 | I am a good planner. |
|15 | I am a good judge of character. |
|16 | I am a good judge of character. |
|17 | I am a good judge of character. |
|18 | I am a good judge of character. |
|19 | I am a good judge of character. |
|20 | I am a good judge of character. |

(Feel free to skip any that don’t apply.)

Once you’ve filled in your ratings, just let me know the list of numbers (e.g., `[4, 2, 5, ...]`) and I’ll calculate your personality traits for you.
